sources.title: ZED X One S product
sources.supports: ZED-414012 fisheye SKU; camera only in box; F-F cable and mounts are extra options; GMSL2 PoC.

sources.title: ZED X One specifications
sources.supports: ZED X One S fisheye body 25x25x34.2 mm and 36 g; typical 0.89 W; minimum SDK 4.2. No fisheye IP69K claim.

sources.title: ZED Link Capture Card Duo product
sources.supports: ACC-210000; includes 0.5 m 1-to-4 M-F cable plus 3 M2.5x20 screws and 3 16 mm spacers; J501 direct AGX connector.

sources.title: Duo on AGX Orin setup
sources.supports: Board powered by official AGX devkit; direct camera connector mounting; power off before connecting. Ports 0/1 Group A, 2/3 Group B. Up to 2 S cameras/group HD1200@60.

sources.title: Jetson regional developer kit part numbers
sources.supports: AGX Orin 64GB complete devkit 945-13730-0050-000 region US/CA/CN/TW/JP; 0055 and 0057 are regional variants.

sources.title: AGX Orin quick start
sources.supports: Complete kit includes module/carrier/Wi-Fi/USB-C PSU/USB A-C cable. Headless initial setup supported. Do not follow latest JP7 version from this mutable hardware guide for this pinned JP6 bench.

sources.title: AGX Orin hardware layout
sources.supports: J509 camera connector; J24 above DC jack; J40 next to 40-pin for flashing; eMMC default storage. No DP over USB-C.

sources.title: AGX Orin how-to
sources.supports: USB PD source ratings include 20 V 4.5 A; bundled PSU; recovery instructions; USB device virtual Ethernet and serial.

sources.title: GMSL2 cable selection guide
sources.supports: Camera connector male; Duo uses four-wire male to four female fanout; extensions require M-F. Couplings affect signal integrity; not a robot flex qualification.

sources.title: GMSL2 1-to-4 M-F cable
sources.supports: CBL-320500; 0.5 m; RTK031; FAKRA universal Z.

sources.title: GMSL2 M-F extension cable
sources.supports: 1.5 m variant CBL-310100; M-F; RTK031; universal Z. No dynamic bend/twist rating established.

sources.title: Camera mount for ZED X One S
sources.supports: Plate ACC-151200; 22x20x6.2 mm; bottom 1/4-20 UNC; includes screw kit.

sources.title: PIXI Mini Tripod black
sources.supports: MTPIXI-B; fixed 1/4-20 male screw; 1 kg rated payload; +/-35 deg tilt. Selected only for independent static camera stands.

sources.title: Enclosure for Orin AGX devkit
sources.supports: ACC-221000; optional enclosure recommended by AGX Duo guide.
